raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-18 (698 rows vs ~350 normal), so the same txn_ids are ingested twice; the sample shows exact copies, and the raw txn_id range is contiguous with 4975 distinct ids against 5324 rows. silver_transactions keeps every copy, which inflates the 2026-01-17 volume and the gold aggregates. Deduplicating on txn_id to the latest ingest_ts before applying the POSTED filter removes the re-sent copies without changing the output columns.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
